target_dsns.description: List of PostgreSQL DSNs (connection strings) to monitor. Each DSN follows format: postgresql://user:pass@host:port/dbname?sslmode=disable

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a PostgreSQL connection per scrape before timing out.

disabled_collectors.description: List of collector names to disable. Use '--no-collector help' to list available collectors.

items.description: Name of a collector to disable (e.g., 'bgwriter', 'database', 'process')

enabled_collectors.description: List of collector names to *only* enable (overrides default enabled set). If empty, most collectors are enabled by default.

items.description: Name of a collector to enable (e.g., 'stat_activity', 'replication')

log_level.description: Verbosity of exporter logs. One of: debug, info, warn, error.

web_listen_address.description: Network interface and port to expose metrics (e.g., '127.0.0.1:9187' to restrict to local host).

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file for HTTPS on the exporter endpoint. Leave empty to disable TLS.

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (must accompany tls_cert_file).

basic_auth_user.description: Username for basic auth on the /metrics endpoint. Leave empty to disable auth.

basic_auth_pass.description: Password for basic auth on the /metrics endpoint. Must be set if basic_auth_user is set.

query_path.description: Path to custom YAML file defining additional queries/metrics. See upstream docs for format.

pg_version.description: Explicitly set PostgreSQL version (e.g., '14.0') to override auto-detection. Useful for proxy layers (e.g., pgBouncer).

export_database_size.description: Enable collection of per-database size (uses pg_database.datsize). Slight performance impact.

export_table_bloat.description: Enable estimation of table bloat (requires pg_stat_statements extension). May be slow on large schemas.

wal_lag_warning.description: Minimum WAL lag (in bytes) to trigger a warning alert for streaming replication.

wal_lag_critical.description: Minimum WAL lag (in bytes) to trigger a critical alert for streaming replication.
